title: policy/runs.yaml
description: The run launcher's limits (Plan 02): how many runs may be live, how long finished runs are kept and how large each run output may be. Every key is required: the loader fills no defaults.

max_live.description: Runs that may be live (queued or running) at once; the launcher refuses the next one.

retention_days.description: Days a finished run's files are kept before the launcher prunes them.

output_limits_mb.description: The largest size in MB of each file a run may write; the launcher stops a run that exceeds one.
